instruction: What is Chedo Tech?
response: Chedo Tech is a programming institute and app development center in Pune, Maharashtra, India. It provides offline, practical programming education since 2015, taking students from fundamentals to building real projects with personal guidance.

instruction: When was Chedo Tech established?
response: Chedo Tech has been providing practical programming education since 2015.

instruction: Does Chedo Tech offer online classes?
response: Chedo Tech focuses on fully offline, in-person classroom training. Official pages do not advertise a standard remote or pre-recorded lecture model. Students practice on their own machines with the instructor present in the room.

instruction: What is the teaching philosophy of Chedo Tech?
response: Chedo Tech believes that you learn to program by programming. Their approach is Understand → Practice → Build → Debug → Improve. Classes use live coding on the whiteboard, not screen-sharing or pre-recorded lectures.

instruction: How does Chedo Tech teach programming?
response: Classes are fully offline. Concepts are drawn on the whiteboard, code is written live by the instructor, and students practice on their own machines while the instructor is right there for personal guidance. Printed notes, a mobile app, and milestone checkpoints support the learning.

instruction: What is the core belief of Chedo Tech?
response: You learn to program by programming.

instruction: What is the learning loop at Chedo Tech?
response: Understand → Practice → Build → Debug → Improve. This is the loop that turns students into developers.

instruction: What is the Google rating of Chedo Tech?

instruction: What courses does Chedo Tech offer?
response: Chedo Tech offers twelve focused practical courses covering C, C++, Java, Python, DSA, MERN Full Stack, Java Full Stack, Data Science, Flutter Mobile App Development, UI/UX Design, and Kids Programming (ages 7–16).

instruction: List all courses available at Chedo Tech.
response: Foundation: C Programming, C++ Programming, Java Programming, Python Programming, C + C++ + DSA, Java + DSA, Python + DSA, Data Structures & Algorithms. Full Stack: MERN Full Stack, Java Full Stack. Data & AI: Data Science Foundation, Data Science. Mobile: Flutter Mobile App Development. Design: UI/UX Design. Kids: Kids Programming for ages 7–16.

instruction: Does Chedo Tech have courses for kids?
response: Yes. Chedo Tech offers Kids Programming for ages 7–16 with four levels: Beginner (Scratch, logic, computer basics), Intermediate (Python, HTML), Advanced (games, intro to AI), and Mastery (projects and certificate).

instruction: What is the Kids Programming course at Chedo Tech?
response: Kids Programming at Chedo Tech is for ages 7–16. It has four levels. Beginner covers computer basics, typing, logic, puzzles, Scratch and simple games. Intermediate introduces Python and HTML. Advanced covers game development and intro to AI. Mastery includes final projects and a certificate. Classes are offline with live coding and small batches.

instruction: What is taught in the Java + DSA Foundation course?
response: The Java + DSA Foundation course covers Core Java, OOP, Java Collections Framework, Data Structures, Algorithms, and problem-solving for technical interviews. It has nine phases including Java Foundation, Object-Oriented Java, Advanced Java + Collections, DSA Foundation, Linear Data Structures, Algorithms, Trees + Graphs, Advanced Problem Solving, and Interview Preparation.

instruction: What is the MERN Full Stack course at Chedo Tech?
response: The MERN Full Stack Development course at Chedo Tech is offline classroom training covering HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT authentication, Socket.IO, Docker, CI/CD, and AI integration with LLM APIs and RAG. Students build real projects including e-commerce, real-time chat, and a production-style capstone.

instruction: What technologies are covered in MERN Full Stack at Chedo Tech?
response: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, ES6+, TypeScript, React, React Router, Redux Toolkit, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, JWT, Docker, GitHub Actions, Jest, Vercel/Render, and AI integration with LLM APIs and vector databases.

instruction: Does Chedo Tech teach Data Science?
response: Yes. Chedo Tech offers Data Science Foundation and full Data Science courses covering Python, Pandas, statistics, Machine Learning, Power BI, real data handling, and dashboard building. There are also crash courses marketed for 10th and 12th students.

instruction: What is the Data Science course at Chedo Tech?
response: Chedo Tech’s Data Science courses cover Python programming, data handling with Pandas, statistics, Machine Learning, Power BI, and building real dashboards. Foundation tracks are beginner-friendly and require no prior coding experience. Offline, project-based training is provided.

instruction: Does Chedo Tech teach Flutter?
response: Yes. Chedo Tech offers Mobile App Development using Flutter. Students learn Dart, Flutter framework, Firebase, API integration, state management (Riverpod/Bloc/GetX), Hive, Git, app deployment to Android and iOS, and monetization. Projects include e-commerce apps, real-time chat, weather apps, and a startup MVP.

instruction: What is the Mobile App Development course at Chedo Tech?
response: It is a Flutter-based course teaching Dart, Flutter, Firebase backend, APIs, UI/UX, state management, Git, and deployment. Students build real Android and iOS apps such as e-commerce, chat, weather, location tracker, and a complete startup MVP.

instruction: Does Chedo Tech teach UI/UX Design?
response: Yes. Chedo Tech offers a UI/UX Design course covering Figma, Canva, AI-powered workflows, building interfaces, design systems, and brand experiences.

instruction: What programming languages are taught at Chedo Tech?
response: C, C++, Java, and Python are taught as foundation languages, along with JavaScript/TypeScript in full-stack tracks and Dart in the Flutter course.

instruction: Is prior coding knowledge required to join Chedo Tech?
response: No. The website states that no prior coding knowledge is required for foundation tracks. Beginners are welcome.

instruction: How do I enroll at Chedo Tech?
response: Visit the center at Ultima Business Center, Kondhwa Budruk, Pune to meet instructors, plan your curriculum, get study material, and enroll with a learning schedule. You can also enquire via WhatsApp on +91 87931 00815 or the contact form on the website.

instruction: What is the learning journey at Chedo Tech?
response: The five-step learning journey is: 1. Foundation (C / C++ / Java / Python), 2. Problem Solving (Logic + DSA), 3. Specialization (Full Stack / Data Science / Mobile / Design), 4. Projects (Build real applications), 5. Confidence (Understand → Build → Debug → Improve).

instruction: What support tools does Chedo Tech provide to students?
response: Printed notes, a mobile app for notes/assignments/schedules/announcements, assignments and coding tests, project checkpoints for milestone tracking, AI visualizations and smart boards, and in-person doubt resolution.

instruction: Does Chedo Tech give certificates?
response: Yes. Certificates are mentioned for the Kids Programming Mastery level and some other tracks such as the mobile app development program.

instruction: What projects do students build at Chedo Tech?
response: Students build real applications such as Student Record/Management System, E-commerce website or app, real-time Chat Application, Data Analysis dashboards, Weather API app, Location Tracker, Admin Dashboard, Task Manager, Dockerized MERN systems, and AI knowledge-base / RAG apps.

instruction: Is Chedo Tech only for beginners?
response: No. Chedo Tech serves beginners to advanced learners. Foundation courses start from zero, while specialization tracks like MERN Full Stack, Data Science, and Flutter go deeper into professional development skills and interview preparation.

instruction: What is the difference between Chedo Tech and online coding platforms?
response: Chedo Tech is fully offline. Instructors teach live on the whiteboard, students code on their own machines in class, and personal guidance is available in real time. It avoids screen-sharing and pre-recorded lecture models.

instruction: Does Chedo Tech offer placement guarantee?
response: The MERN Full Stack page notes career support and interview preparation but explicitly states no placement guarantees. Placement outcomes are individual and not officially published as guaranteed.

instruction: What is taught in the C Programming course at Chedo Tech?
response: C Programming is offered as a foundation course focusing on practical coding, logic building, and hands-on practice as part of the overall programming foundation path.

instruction: What is taught in the Python Programming course?
response: Python Programming covers basics, control flow, functions, data structures (lists, dictionaries, tuples), modules, file handling, debugging, OOP, and error handling. It is also used in Data Science and Kids Intermediate levels.

instruction: Does Chedo Tech teach Data Structures and Algorithms?
response: Yes. DSA is taught both as a standalone course and combined with languages (Java + DSA, Python + DSA, C + C++ + DSA). Topics include Big-O analysis, arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting, searching, recursion, backtracking, greedy algorithms, and dynamic programming.

instruction: What is covered in the Trees and Graphs section of Java + DSA?
response: Binary trees, BST operations, AVL trees, heap priority queues, adjacency lists and matrices, BFS, DFS, topological sort, Dijkstra, Kruskal, Prim, and Bellman-Ford algorithms.

instruction: What interview preparation is included in Java + DSA?
response: Pattern recognition (sliding window, two-pointers, prefix sum, monotonic stacks), JVM memory, garbage collection, overloading vs overriding, ArrayList vs LinkedList, HashMap internals, and Comparable vs Comparator.

instruction: What backend technologies are taught in MERN Full Stack?
response: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, MongoDB with Mongoose, PostgreSQL, Redis, JWT authentication, API security, and Socket.IO for real-time features.

instruction: Does the MERN course include DevOps?
response: Yes. It covers Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Jest testing, and deployment to Vercel or Render.

instruction: Is AI included in any Chedo Tech courses?
response: Yes. The MERN Full Stack course includes AI integration with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases. Kids Programming introduces AI concepts at advanced levels. Data Science covers Machine Learning.

instruction: What is the target age for Kids Programming at Chedo Tech?
response: Ages 7 to 16.

instruction: What does a Beginner Kids Programming student learn?
response: Computer basics, typing, mouse and file handling, logic building, puzzles, patterns, Scratch block coding, simple animations, and games.

instruction: What does an Intermediate Kids Programming student learn?
response: Python basics (variables, loops, conditions), problem-solving challenges, web basics with HTML, simple websites, and mini projects.
